summary: Frontend-only verification of 3 follow-up fixes on artirdim.com preview. (1) Subtle scrollbar: PASS - computed html scrollbar-color is 'rgba(128,128,128,0.22) rgba(0,0,0,0)' (transparent track), webkit rules from theme-new.css are width 6px, track transparent, thumb rgba(128,128,128,0.22), hover 0.4; zero remaining scrollbar rules referencing var(--primary)/blue. (2) Auth pages mobile no-scroll: PASS - /login at 390x844 -> scrollHeight 844 == innerHeight 844, scrollY stays 0 after scroll attempt; at 360x640 -> documentElement scrollHeight 640 == innerHeight, scrollY 0 (body/#kt_app_root inner content measures 662px but nothing is scrollable or visibly clipped in screenshot). /register at 390x844 -> scrollHeight 844, scrollY 0, form reachable/not clipped. Scrollbar color on auth pages is the new subtle grey. (3) Mobile sidebar auto-close: PASS x2 - logged in as buyer@test.com at 390x844, hamburger #kt_app_sidebar_mobile_toggle opened drawer (class drawer-on + .drawer-overlay present, body overflow hidden); clicking 'Muzayedeler' (/browse/auctions) and data-testid=sidebar-buyer-orders (/orders) both navigated AND drawer auto-closed (drawer-on removed, overlay removed, body overflow restored to 'hidden auto').

issues: Minor cosmetic: the tagline text under the 'artirdim.com' logo appears faded/overlapping the underline decoration, looking like a rendering artifact (see logo block). Not a functional issue.
Inner #kt_app_root content height computes 662px vs 640px viewport while the document is not scrollable; no clipping observed in screenshot, but worth a quick visual check on very short devices.

critical_code_review_comments: AppLayout.vue router.on('start') listener correctly cleaned up in onUnmounted - good. Consider also hiding the drawer on 'finish' as a safety net if a navigation is cancelled.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 items from this round (subtle scrollbar, auth mobile no-scroll, mobile sidebar auto-close on Inertia nav) verified passing at 1920x1080, 390x844 and 360x640. Only remaining observations are cosmetic (login logo tagline artifact) and /storage/auctions/*.jpg 403 image errors (known/ignored).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - fixes confirmed effective. Previous root causes (height:100vh on mobile auth root, blue primary scrollbar thumb, missing drawer hide on Inertia navigation) are all resolved in the live preview assets.
